title: GitHub Copilot for JetBrains 1.5.55
body_markdown:
* Added: **Next Edit Suggestions (NES):** Enhanced auto-completion to anticipate your next edit.
* Added: **Prompt Files:** Support for **.prompt.md** files, which allow defining project-scoped prompt customization in the **.github/prompts** directory.
* Added: **Built-in Tools Management:** Built-in tools management view in the Agent mode UI.
* Added: **Shared Sessions:** Seamless switching between Ask mode and Agent mode without content loss.
* Added: **Setting on delay for Auto-Accept :** Configure a delay after which suggested edits are automatically accepted.
* Added: Support Bring your own Key for Azure, OpenAI, Gemini, Groq, Anthropic and OpenRouter providers
* Added: **Image Paste Support:** Paste images directly into the conversation.
* Added: **Terminal Auto-Approve:** Set specific commands or patterns to auto-approve without manual confirmation.
* Added: Updated MCP Stdio uv server close logic
* Added: Support cancel token for MCP tool calling
* Fixed: Extra white border in the text input panel.
* Fixed: Slow loading of menu items when first opened from the status icon.
* Fixed: **Various Fixes and UX Improvements**
